walls: North, east and west interior-facing single-sided planes; no south wall or opaque ceiling. Exterior orbit cameras can see into the room.
lighting: Visible LED fixture geometry only. Actual lighting is added by the host.
anchors_are: Actor sole/root support positions, not hip positions or clinical fixed test distances.

orientation_advice.patient_at_stool_facing: north / -Z, yaw PI if the avatar front is +Z
orientation_advice.therapist_at_chair_facing: south / +Z, yaw 0 if the avatar front is +Z
orientation_advice.exam_patient_facing: east / +X, yaw PI/2; seated root is 0.06m east of stool centre
orientation_advice.exam_therapist_facing: west / -X, yaw -PI/2; standing reference is not verified manual contact

seated_clearance_iteration.note: Adjusted to the authored seated clip feet extending 0.38–0.43m toward local +Z and seat centre 0.06m behind root. Bedside check uses its own stool, not the higher bed. Actual skin collision remains to be viewed.

desk_iteration.reason: Complete monitor assembly rotated toward the therapist; keyboard and mouse moved to the therapist side. Mouse sits on the therapist right. Side offset still clears the dialogue sightline.
desk_iteration.documentation: Clinical notes and pen directly on desk when not carried; no standalone PreparationTray

setActivity.accepted: string or object with id/activity/zone, optional mat and supportRail booleans
setActivity.mat_visible: balance zone AND mat=true or soft/foam/mat suffix
setActivity.zone_markers: Only selected zone corner markings appear

props: Rounded reception desk with monitor and keyboard; original portable notes and pen directly on desk, without a stationery tray
Clinician office chair, two patient reception stools and separate 0.45m bedside examination stool
Examination bed with cover, pillow, runner and conditionally visible lamp
Existing bedside trolley with goniometer and sealed swabs; blocks retained
Five contiguous floor-level pressure teaching plates, each .8 m × .55 m; no real device specification
2.5 metre short observation guide and red marks
Three original mesh-based anatomy posters: skeleton/joint landmarks, anterior/posterior muscles, right lower-leg/ankle muscles

Teaching shelf: upper foot silhouette teaching props, 2 flat-base kettlebells, 2 hex dumbbells, 1 spiked massage ball, 1 smooth fascia ball, 3 flat resistance loops, slant board and stored balance pad
Optional balance pad and temporary support rail; host can enable the rail for hard-ground balance teaching
